Author: Vivek Varma
Bench: Vivek Varma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:172597

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 10616 of 2024

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mirza Ali Zulfaqar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Shashank Shekhar Pandey, learned AGA and perused the material placed on record.

2. This application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 107 of 2024, under sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act, Police Station Dumariyaganj, District Siddharth Nagar.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is the married sister-in-law of the deceased and has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The deceased was married with the brother of the applicant in the year 2019.
In the alleged incident the brother of the applicant (husband of the deceased) has also received injuries, while trying to save the deceased.

At the time of alleged Sanno @ Rabiya Khatoon vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41665627/
1 incident, the applicant was living separately with her husband at Lucknow.

entities.text: Sanno @ Rabiya Khatoon vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is next contended that the mother-in-law of the deceased Aaliya Begum has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 16.10.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 9788 of 2024 (Aaliya Begum Vs. State of U.P.).

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 9788 of 2024 (Aaliya Begum Vs. State of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
It is next submitted that the investigation is going on and the applicant has apprehension of her arrest in the above mentioned case.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the application for grant of anticipatory bail be confined only till the submission of the police report.

6. Having regard to the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant, considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, in particular of the fact, that in the alleged incident the brother of the applicant (husband of the deceased) has also received injuries, the mother-in-law of the deceased Aaliya Begum has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court

,
without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail till the submission of police report.
8. In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.

9. The Investigating Officer is directed to conclude the investigation of the present case in accordance with law expeditiously preferably within a period of three months from the date of production of a copy of this order independently without being prejudiced by any observation made by this Court while considering and deciding the present anticipatory bail application of the Sanno @ Rabiya Khatoon vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41665627/
2 applicant.
10.

entities.text: Sanno @ Rabiya Khatoon vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is directed to produce a copy of this order before the S.S.P./S.P. concerned within ten days from today, who shall ensure the compliance of present order.

11. The application stands disposed of.
